## Overview

### Why

fallow reports `LiveDemo.tsx` and `registrySources.ts` as unreachable, and nothing imports either file. Deleting them is the unused-files step of the fallow cleanup.

### Behavior change

None. Nothing called either file.

### Checks

- `fallow dead-code --trace-file` finds no importer of either file.
- `fallow dead-code --unused-files` reports nothing after the deletion.

### Not covered

The rest of the fallow cleanup lands in other pull requests.

## Delete LiveDemo

`LiveDemo` wrapped a demo in a box with a fullscreen button. The demo islands replaced it, and it has had no importers since.
